summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting to signed-in account  ### What I found by reading the code (no changes made) The backend wiring actually looks correct: - `modules/watchlist/schema.ts` keys watchlists by `user_id` (not anonymous/global). - `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` has its own auth middleware that reads the `arca_session` cookie, validates it via `getSession()`, and sets `X-User-Id` before every handler; all queries filter `eq(watchlists.user_id, userId)`. - `client/src/lib/api.ts` sends `credentials: "include"` on every request, so cookies should go out. - `client
